comment: Plan 253 (docs/cloud/253-latency-contract.md). Edited by hand; videorc-web keeps a byte copy in tests/fixtures/room-latency.json. `blocks` and `relays`: in -> parseNetBlock / parseLatencyRelay -> out (null: refused). `samples`: stats reports at both ends of a window -> netBlock(readNetStats(before), readNetStats(after), windowMs). `room`: held blocks -> roomLatency. Every time is a duration or a holder's own clock (D1).

blocks.name: unknown keys are left out at every level, never kept
an empty send block is left out
a round trip over the bound
partial that is not a boolean
send that is not an object
from that is not a list
a sender's number out of bounds

samples.name: a Chromium guest: the selected pair, both buffers, playout, two simulcast layers
a guest whose browser has no playout stat and no pair: the RTCP round trip, and partial
the first sample has nothing to subtract from: no block
a window under a second: no block
a window over a minute (the page slept): no block
counters that did not move and a track that appeared inside the window give no part

room.name: everyone reports: both directions, the record's video, the program
partial: a guest's browser reports no playout, so the figure is a floor
missing part: a guest block with no round trip gives no number
missing part: the guest does not hear the host yet, so one direction and partial
missing part: neither end has the other's buffer, so no number
missing part: the host has no round trip, so nobody has a number
stale: a report 25 s old still counts
stale: a report older than 25 s disappears, the others stay
stale: the host's own sample is too old, so there is no number at all
a report stamped after now is not current
a page loaded before the deploy sends no block: no program number
the host's camera is off: no send time, so no program number and no video to the guest
the page decodes no picture from the host: no program number
two program pages: the slower one is the program
a report that claims the host's identity is ignored
